# 网易云游戏 + 无限暖暖 UI 导航包

网易云游戏提供方和无限暖暖日常功能已合并为一个可直接运行的导航包。图片资源以内嵌 Base64 保存；`.disabled` OCR 图片保持禁用，不会被转换为普通点击动作。每日灵感和星海拾光的最终页面尚未采集稳定 State 图片，因此对应目标会在最终状态识别后完成。

```navigation-json
{
  "metadata": {
    "id": "netease-cloud-infinity-nikki-ui",
    "name": "网易云游戏 + 无限暖暖 UI 导航",
    "version": "2026.09"
  },
  "scenarios": [
    {
      "id": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "title": "网易云游戏启动无限暖暖官服",
      "priority": 100,
      "navigators": [
        "ui"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-daily",
      "title": "无限暖暖每日灵感和星海拾光",
      "priority": 80,
      "navigators": [
        "ui"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "states": [
    {
      "id": "cloudgame-home",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "uis": [
        "cloudgame-home"
      ],
      "topmost": "cloudgame-home",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "home-recommend",
          "threshold": 0.86
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "my-page",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "uis": [
        "my-page"
      ],
      "topmost": "my-page",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "history-title",
          "threshold": 0.86
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "server-select",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "uis": [
        "server-select"
      ],
      "topmost": "server-select",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "server-title",
          "threshold": 0.9
        },
        {
          "assetId": "normal-selected",
          "threshold": 0.82
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "ad-offer",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "uis": [
        "ad-offer"
      ],
      "topmost": "ad-offer",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "ad-title",
          "threshold": 0.86
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "game-running",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "uis": [
        "game-running",
        "game-world"
      ],
      "topmost": "game-running",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "game-world",
          "threshold": 0.7
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-world",
      "scenarioId": "infinity-daily",
      "uis": [
        "infinity-world",
        "world"
      ],
      "topmost": "infinity-world",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "world",
          "threshold": 0.82
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "calendar",
      "scenarioId": "infinity-daily",
      "uis": [
        "world",
        "calendar"
      ],
      "topmost": "calendar",
      "markers": [
        {
          "assetId": "calendar-title",
          "threshold": 0.86
        }
      ],
      "matches": [
        {
          "assetId": "daily-card",
          "threshold": 0.82,
          "matchId": "daily-inspiration",
          "gotoFlow": "infinity-open-daily-inspiration",
          "doneState": "daily-inspiration"
        },
        {
          "assetId": "star-card",
          "threshold": 0.82,
          "matchId": "star-sea-pickup",
          "gotoFlow": "infinity-open-star-sea-pickup",
          "doneState": "star-sea-pickup"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "flows": [
    {
      "id": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-my",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-my",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "my-tab",
          "threshold": 0.9,
          "goto": "flow:cloud-my-page:select-official"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "cloud-my-page",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "select-official",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "select-official",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "official-history",
          "threshold": 0.86,
          "goto": "flow:cloud-select-normal:tap-normal"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "cloud-select-normal",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-normal",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-normal",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "normal-play",
          "threshold": 0.9,
          "goto": "flow:cloud-skip-ad:tap-discard"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "cloud-skip-ad",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-discard",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-discard",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "discard-benefit",
          "threshold": 0.9,
          "goto": "flow:cloud-enter-game:enter-actions"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "cloud-enter-game",
      "scenarioId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "enter-actions",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "enter-actions",
          "kind": "choice",
          "candidates": [
            {
              "id": "close-daily-reward",
              "kind": "action",
              "assetId": "daily-reward-close",
              "threshold": 0.84,
              "goto": "enter-actions"
            },
            {
              "id": "play-tip",
              "kind": "action",
              "assetId": "play-tip",
              "threshold": 0.84,
              "goto": "enter-actions"
            },
            {
              "id": "enter-game",
              "kind": "action",
              "assetId": "enter-game-button",
              "threshold": 0.78,
              "goto": "flow:infinity-open-calendar:tap-calendar"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-open-calendar",
      "scenarioId": "infinity-daily",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-calendar",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-calendar",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "calendar-button",
          "threshold": 0.82,
          "goto": "route-calendar"
        },
        {
          "id": "route-calendar",
          "kind": "choice",
          "branches": [
            {
              "goto": "flow:infinity-open-daily-inspiration:tap-card"
            },
            {
              "goto": "flow:infinity-open-star-sea-pickup:tap-card"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-open-daily-inspiration",
      "scenarioId": "infinity-daily",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-card",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-card",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "daily-card",
          "threshold": 0.82,
          "goto": "await-daily-inspiration"
        },
        {
          "id": "await-daily-inspiration",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-open-star-sea-pickup",
      "scenarioId": "infinity-daily",
      "navigator": "ui",
      "start": "tap-card",
      "steps": [
        {
          "id": "tap-card",
          "kind": "action",
          "assetId": "star-card",
          "threshold": 0.82,
          "goto": "await-star-sea-pickup"
        },
        {
          "id": "await-star-sea-pickup",
          "kind": "terminal",
          "terminal": true
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "goals": [
    {
      "id": "infinity-nikki-open-game",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "period": "version",
      "success": "state.topmost == \"game-running\"",
      "launch": {
        "packageName": "com.netease.android.cloudgame",
        "activityName": ".activity.SplashActivity",
        "displayId": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-nikki-daily-inspiration",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "period": "daily",
      "success": "state.topmost == \"daily-inspiration\"",
      "launch": {
        "packageName": "com.netease.android.cloudgame",
        "activityName": ".activity.SplashActivity",
        "displayId": 0
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "infinity-nikki-star-sea-pickup",
      "kind": "ui",
      "delegate": "ui",
      "flowId": "cloud-bootstrap",
      "period": "daily",
      "success": "state.topmost == \"star-sea-pickup\"",
      "launch": {
        "packageName": "com.netease.android.cloudgame",
        "activityName": ".activity.SplashActivity",
        "displayId": 0
      }
    }
  ]
}
```
